name: B10-0419/2026 (ECR) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls for the immediate release of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro, both held in Cuba, and of all political prisoners there. It asks the Cuban government to step down and allow free elections. It also wants the European Union to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba and to impose targeted sanctions on those responsible for the repression.

- The report changes no law; it is a set of political demands on Cuba and the European Union.
- It concerns Félix and Saylí Navarro, other Cuban prisoners, and the Cuban government.
- Next, the European Union's diplomatic service and member states would decide whether to act on the demands.
